title: StreamJob
description: Job details for a stream analysis.

agentParticipantId.description: participant id of agent where results need to be sent

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer, and boolean types are supported.

A key-value pair representing predefined tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

definedTags.description:
Defined tags for this resource. Each key is predefined and scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"foo-namespace": {"bar-key": "value"}}`

features.description: a list of document analysis features.

freeformTags.description:
A simple key-value pair that is applied without any predefined name, type, or scope. It exists for cross-compatibility only.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

lifecycleDetails.description: Additional details about current state of streamJob

lifecycleState.description: The current state of the Stream job.

additionalProperties.description: The value of the tag. Only string, integer, and boolean types are supported.

A key-value pair representing system tags' keys and values scoped to a namespace.
For example: `{"bar-key": "value"}`

systemTags.description:
Usage of system tag keys. These predefined keys are scoped to namespaces.
For example: `{"orcl-cloud": {"free-tier-retained": "true"}}`

timeCreated.description: When the streamJob was created, as an RFC3339 datetime string.

timeUpdated.description: When the stream job was updated, as an RFC3339 datetime string.

StreamOutputLocation.description: Details about a where results will be Sent

outputLocationType.description:
Type of output location
Allowed values are:
- OBJECT_STORAGE

VideoStreamFeature.description: Details about a stream video feature request.

featureType.description:
The feature of video analysis.
Allowed values are:
- OBJECT_TRACKING: Object tracking feature(OT).
- FACE_DETECTION: Face detection feature(FD).
- OBJECT_DETECTION: Object detection feature(OD)
